proposals.evidence: The entire response is elder/big + brother. Turner 11225 supplies regional baḍ-/baṛ-/boḍ- big/elder (including the addendum’s qualification of its prehistoric origin); 9661 supplies bhāi/bhirā and related brother forms. Both ordered components are represented, preserving the affectionate bhaiyā and regional brother endings.
